_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — automation-designer, extended by automation-approval-steps. Adds the `Automation` schema to the shared `openbuild` register: a single declarative object composing TRIGGER + optional CONDITION + ACTIONS, source-of-truth for `AutomationCompilerService`. Per design.md Decision 1 the designer always renders FROM this object, never by parsing compiled artifacts — the object IS the decompiled form, which is what makes compilation reversible. Compilation targets ONLY existing declarative primitives (ADR-031): `x-openregister-notifications` entries (see 10-business-rules.json:153 for the live dialect shape this compiler writes to), `x-openregister-lifecycle` typed transition actions, manifest `schedules[]` entries (existing `openconnector:synchronization` action only), namespaced RuleSet/ConditionActionRule objects evaluated by the existing RuleEngineService, and — since automation-approval-steps — an OpenRegister `ApprovalChain` (one step, group-only `role`) upserted via OR's `ApprovalChainMapper`/`ApprovalService::initializeChain()`. No new imperative engine is introduced in openbuild. Every artifact id/key the compiler mints carries the `aut-` prefix (rule-set slugs use `aut-<uuid8>`, the approval chain name is `aut-<slug>`) so recompile/delete never touches hand-authored entries — see `provenance` below. Property names are English (new schema; unrelated to the pre-existing Dutch rules-engine schemas). `approval` is selectable in v1 ONLY on `object-created|object-updated|object-deleted|lifecycle-transition` triggers (design.md Decision 1 of automation-approval-steps); `schedule`/`manual` + `approval` remain blocked fail-closed. Assignee is group-only (OR's `ApprovalStep.role` has no per-user primitive — deferred, see automation-approval-steps design.md Open Questions); no escalation-timeout field is exposed (OR has no timeout primitive — omitted entirely from v1 rather than shipping an inert field).

Automation.title: Automation
Automation.description: A single trigger→condition→actions declarative automation, compiled on demand to OpenBuild's existing declarative primitives (notifications dialect, lifecycle actions, schedules, rules engine). One automation is managed as one unit: list/edit/enable/disable/dry-run/delete.

slug.title: Automation Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case slug uniquely identifying the automation within its ApplicationVersion. Drives the `aut-<slug>` namespace of every compiled artifact id/key.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name shown in the Automations list.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional long-form description of what this automation does.

versionUuid.title: Application Version UUID
versionUuid.description: UUID of the owning ApplicationVersion. An automation belongs to exactly one version; branching a version clones its automations with new uuids (design.md Decision 6).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the automation is active. Disabling recompiles with every artifact's own enabled switch off; artifacts stay in place (design.md Decision 5).

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Exactly one trigger: object created/updated/deleted, a lifecycle transition, a cron/interval schedule, or manual (rules-backend) invocation.

schema.title: Target Schema
schema.description: Schema slug the trigger fires on (object-* and lifecycle-transition trigger types).

transition.title: Transition Action
transition.description: The `x-openregister-lifecycle` transition action name (lifecycle-transition trigger type only).

interval.title: Interval (seconds)
interval.description: Cadence in seconds (schedule trigger type; mutually exclusive with `cron`, reusing the schedules-editor cadence presets).

cron.title: Cron Expression
cron.description: 5-field cron expression (schedule trigger type; mutually exclusive with `interval`).

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Optional condition, v1-supported only on the `manual` trigger (design.md Decision 2 — the rules backend is the only existing primitive that evaluates FEEL). Either a FEEL-subset expression or a reference to an existing rule set.

expression.title: FEEL Expression
expression.description: FEEL-subset boolean expression evaluated against the payload (type: feel).

ruleSetSlug.title: Rule Set Slug
ruleSetSlug.description: Slug of an existing RuleSet to defer condition evaluation to (type: rule-set).

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Ordered typed action records. Only combinations allowed by the v1 compilation matrix (design.md Decision 2) may be saved — unsupported combinations are blocked fail-closed in the editor and at compile time.

type.title: Action Type
type.description: `approval` (automation-approval-steps) is selectable only on object-created|object-updated|object-deleted|lifecycle-transition triggers — compiles to an OpenRegister ApprovalChain; blocked fail-closed on schedule/manual.

recipients.title: Notification Recipients
recipients.description: send-notification: recipient records, same shape as the x-openregister-notifications dialect (e.g. { kind: object-acl, permission: manage }).

operation.title: Object Operation
operation.description: object-op: whether to create a new object or update an existing one.

schema.title: Target Schema
schema.description: object-op: schema slug to write to.

fieldMapping.title: Field Mapping
fieldMapping.description: object-op: map of target field name to a `{{payload}}` placeholder template.

payloadTemplate.title: Webhook Payload Template
payloadTemplate.description: webhook: payload body template with `{{payload}}` placeholders.

assigneeGroup.title: Assignee Group
assigneeGroup.description: approval: Nextcloud group id the compiled ApprovalChain's single step is assigned to (group-only in v1 — OR's ApprovalStep.role has no per-user primitive).

onApprove.title: On Approve
onApprove.description: approval: follow-up actions dispatched when the compiled ApprovalStep is approved, composed from the same typed-action vocabulary (send-notification/object-op/webhook) as the top-level actions[] array.

onReject.title: On Reject
onReject.description: approval: follow-up actions dispatched when the compiled ApprovalStep is rejected, composed from the same typed-action vocabulary as onApprove.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Every artifact the last compile produced, plus the compiled-plan hash used for idempotency and drift detection (design.md Decision 4).

notificationKeys.title: Notification Keys
notificationKeys.description: x-openregister-notifications entries keyed `aut-<slug>-<n>` on the named schema.

lifecycleActions.title: Lifecycle Actions
lifecycleActions.description: x-openregister-lifecycle transition actions tagged with an `aut-<slug>` marker field.

scheduleIds.title: Schedule IDs
scheduleIds.description: manifest.schedules[] entry ids compiled by this automation.

ruleSetSlug.title: Rule Set Slug
ruleSetSlug.description: The `aut-<uuid8>` RuleSet compiled for a manual-trigger automation, or null.

approvalChainName.title: Approval Chain Name
approvalChainName.description: The `aut-<slug>` OpenRegister ApprovalChain name compiled for an approval-action automation, or null. Enable/disable/delete removes exactly this provenance-listed chain (automation-approval-steps).

openconnectorObjects.title: OpenConnector Objects
openconnectorObjects.description: Reserved for future OpenConnector-materialised artifacts (e.g. webhook call configs).

compiledHash.title: Compiled Hash
compiledHash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical-JSON compiled plan. Recomputed by the status endpoint to detect drift.
